interface.name: treeland_personalization_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to customize display effects.

request.name: get_window_context
request.description: set window background, shadow based on context

request.name: get_cursor_context
request.description: Create a cursor customization context for configuring the system cursor.

request.name: get_font_context

description.summary: custom treeland and window global font context

request.description: custom treeland and window global font context

request.name: get_appearance_context

description.summary: custom treeland window global settings context

request.description: custom user treeland window appearance global

interface.name: treeland_personalization_cursor_context_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client personalization cursor.

request.name: set_theme
request.description: Set the system cursor theme name.

request.name: get_theme
request.description: Query the current system cursor theme name. The compositor will respond with a theme event.

request.name: get_size
request.description: Query the current system cursor size. The compositor will respond with a size event.

event.name: verfity
event.description: Send this signal after commit cursor configure.

arg.name: success
arg.summary: check whether the configuration is successful

event.name: theme
event.description: Sent when the system cursor theme has changed.

event.name: size
event.description: Sent when the system cursor size has changed.

interface.name: treeland_personalization_window_context_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to customize per-window visual properties including background blend mode, round corner radius, shadow, border, and titlebar visibility.

enum.name: blend_mode
enum.description: Window blend mode defines how compositor composite window's surface over other surfaces.

entry.name: transparent
entry.summary: Normal blend mode, just composite over background with alpha channel

entry.name: blur
entry.summary: Blur the content of the window background

request.name: set_round_corner_radius
request.description: This request will set window round corner radius, invoking this request means user want to manage window round corner radius by itself. If not invoked, window round corner radius will be decided by compositor.

arg.name: radius
arg.summary: window round corner radius in pixels

request.name: set_shadow
request.description: Set window shadow's radius, offset and color. When enabled, the client manages the window shadow itself. - radius = -1: enable shadow with system default parameters - radius = 0: disable shadow completely - radius > 0: enable shadow with custom parameters If not invoked, the compositor uses its default behavior.

arg.name: radius
arg.summary: shadow radius, -1 for system default, 0 to disable

request.name: set_border
request.description: Set window border width and color. When enabled, the client manages the window border itself. - width = -1: enable border with system default parameters - width = 0: disable border completely - width > 0: enable border with custom parameters If not invoked, the compositor uses its default behavior.

arg.name: width
arg.summary: border width in pixels, -1 for system default, 0 to disable

request.name: set_titlebar

description.summary: set if system titlebar is enabled

request.description: Set system titlebar state. - mode = enable: force show the system titlebar - mode = disable: force hide the system titlebar Once set, the compositor will not use its own default behavior for the titlebar. If not invoked, the compositor uses its default behavior.

interface.name: treeland_personalization_font_context_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to configure global font settings including the general font, monospace font, and font size.

event.name: font
event.description: Send this signal after setting the system font.

event.name: monospace_font
event.description: Send this signal after setting the system monospace font.

event.name: font_size
event.description: Send this signal after setting the system font size.

interface.name: treeland_personalization_appearance_context_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to configure global appearance settings including round corner radius, icon theme, active color, window opacity, window theme type, and window titlebar height.

event.name: round_corner_radius
event.description: Send this signal after setting the round corner radius.

event.name: icon_theme
event.description: Send this signal after setting the system icon theme.

event.name: active_color
event.description: Send this signal after setting the system active color

event.name: window_opacity
event.description: Sent when the window opacity has changed.

event.name: window_theme_type
event.description: Send this signal after setting the system theme

event.name: window_titlebar_height
event.description: Send this signal after setting the window titlebar height
